catalogue.name: ES - Empire of Sonnstahl
catalogue.readme:
The armies of Sonnstahl march to the beat of drums and the thunder of cannons. Led by zealous priests and bold knights, these soldiers’ discipline and vigour is famed around the world. Inspired by the example of Sunna, Goddess of Humanity, there may be no limit to the ambition of the Empire of Sonnstahl!

To overcome internal divisions and unite the nation against its enemies is the task of the Emperor. He or she cannot merely be a conqueror on the battlefield. They must also compete in the political arena, navigating the treacherous currents of rival families and religious factions. Thanks to esteemed universities, where magic and technology are refined into effective weapons, Sonnstahl has become a master of many trades, and now seeks to extend its grasp to foreign lands.

rules.name: extra Order
rules.description: The model may impart up to 2 Orders per turn (instead of only 1).

sharedRules.name: Brace of Pistols
sharedRules.description: Shots 2, Range 12″, Str 4, AP 2, no Aim modifier for Moving and Shooting.

sharedRules.name: Cannon
sharedRules.description: Shots 1, Range 72″, Str 10, AP 10, Multiple Wounds (D3+1).

sharedRules.name: Mortar
sharedRules.description: Shots 1, Range 48″, Area Attack (16), no Aim modifier for Long Range.

sharedRules.name: Orders
sharedRules.description:
At the start of the player’s turn, each Marshal may impart 1 of the Orders below to a friendly unit of Light Infantry, Spearmen or Imperial Guard within 8″.
• Fight in Extra Rank
• No Aim modifier for Long Range
• +1 Advance Rate and +2 March Rate
The effect lasts until the end of the next Player Turn. No unit can be targeted twice by the same effect during the same turn.
